newsitem.title: USA: PREMIS to buy back up to $600,000 in shares.
newsitem.headline: PREMIS to buy back up to $600,000 in shares.

text.p: PREMIS Corp said Tuesday its board authorized the repurchase of up to $600,000 of its common shares on the open market.

The company, which earlier today announced a reduction in its Postal "Store of the Future" installations and a delay in the PREMIS OpenStore release, said its stock price has been unduly depressed by what it called "temporary bad news."
PREMIS said the recent news will have only a temporary impact on its goals and objectives.
PREMIS develops and markets a line of information management software systems for retail chains.
Its shares closed closed off 3/4 Tuesday at 1-5/8.
